sources.title: Richard White distinguishes his Gilded Age interpretation from Wiebe’s (2017).

verification.note: Fresh actual institutional primary interview full body read. White’s own answer identifies Hofstadter and Wiebe, then argues strong interventionist government without administrative capacity fostered corruption; the interviewer/byline and answer speaker remain separate.
